packageRules.description: Automerge patch, minor and digest updates once CI is green. This repository ships no artifact of its own: everything here reaches users only after it is vendored into a consumer and passes that consumer's release path, so a green run is a stronger signal here than it is there.

customManagers.description: Pinned container images inside the shared scripts. These live here and nowhere else: a consumer that bumped its VENDORED copy would edit a locked file and fail its own drift check, so the bump has to originate in this repository and reach consumers as a re-vendor.

Version pins annotated with a `# renovate:` comment in the workflows. The tail is deliberately loose so a `pip install pkg==` line matches as readily as an UPPERCASE="value" assignment — the ANNOTATION is the anchor. Kept the same shape as both consumers', so a pattern learned in one repo reads the same in all three.
